author: nerfgun2002
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,
I think that there is a misunderstanding. I don't understand why am I ban for ban evading. It says banned for Ban evading (BryanHuen). Firstly, I just got unbanned, why would I be ban evading. BryanHuen is not even my account too! Just because you think its the same ip,Its my brothers account and I don't use it. I was just playing team fortress 2 and I when I want to come onto avicus I found out I got banned. What is this misunderstanding here? Please look into this matter and take the appropriate actions on the moderator who banned me.
